title: Chapter 139 Sword God Of The Divine Dynasty
content:
Chapter 139 Sword God Of The Divine Dynasty

The deserted city!

Hearing these two words, half of the Divine Dynasty was shocked.

The deserted city is actually a deserted city.

Nowadays, in all the known star fields, who doesn’t know the name of the deserted city?

It is known as the most powerful force to fight against the Divine Dynasty, and there are many powerful people in the Divine Emperor Realm, and even the Fire Spirit Star Domain and the Hungu Star Domain directly surrendered to Huangcheng.

Unexpectedly, the strong man from Huangcheng had already arrived at the Divine Dynasty.

Is this a declaration of war?

In the void, Mu Yu was also a little surprised. He didn't expect that the powerful martial arts god in front of him was actually from the deserted city.

It seems that the rumors are true. Huangcheng does have the strength to confront the Divine Dynasty.

"You don't seem to be good at fighting."

Just as Mu Yu was about to take action, Jiang Bei's words suddenly rang out.

Hearing this, Mu Yu was slightly stunned, then smiled and said, "You can tell if you try this."

As Jiang Bei said, she is indeed not a genius who is good at fighting, but she is the best at assisting.

But in terms of power alone, she is still very terrifying.

The next moment, the staff in his hand began to buzz.

Rumble!

A terrifying thunder emerged out of thin air and rushed directly towards Jiangbei in the distance.

Seeing this scene, Jiang Bei's expression was slightly moved.

Ranged mage?

interesting.

Below, the God Dynasty stared at the battle above.

Even the third-ranked god general in the Divine Dynasty has arrived.

Aren’t the Shepherd God General guarding the extreme south?

Obviously, this should be His Majesty’s edict, otherwise the Shepherd God General would never come back without authorization.

As the third general of the Divine Dynasty, it naturally has some glorious history.

The most terrifying record is that he once led an army of millions, and he stepped down a powerful star field with a super god-level powerhouse without any effort.

And the other party not only occupies a dangerous situation, but also has an army of tens of millions.

With such a record, Mu Yu deserves the third god general.

On the other hand, several gods also returned to the God's dynasty.

Looking at the scene of the battle in the void, everyone frowned.

Although the Shepherd God General is indeed not good at fighting, the Shepherd God General's strength is absolutely terrifying, and even they may not be able to win.

But now it seems that Jiangbei is at ease and is gradually beginning to get closer to Mu Yu.

Once Jiangbei approaches, Mu Yu will lose.

Obviously, Mu Yu also understands this.

So at this moment, Mu Yu kept waving the staff in his hand, and various forces poured out towards Jiangbei in the distance.

boom!

At this moment, Jiang Bei suddenly exerted force, and the ultimate force directly shattered the entire void, including all the attacks carried out by Mu Yu.

"not good!"

Below, a master of the Divine Dynasty exclaimed.

I saw that Jiangbei was extremely fast and he was approaching Mu Yu in an instant.

In terms of close combat, Mu Yu is a scumbag in battle.

What is strange is that Mu Yu had no fear on his face, but instead had a smile.

Seeing this, Jiang Bei frowned slightly.

Buzz —

I saw Mu Yu's figure disappeared from the spot instantly.

The next moment, a terrifying battle slowly emerged from the void.

And Jiangbei is at the center of this formation at this moment.

"Nine Stars Killing Formation, I wonder if you can hold on?"

Outside the formation, Mu Yu's figure slowly appeared, looking at Jiang Bei in the formation with a proud look.

The other powerful people in the Divine Dynasty also didn't react.

Such a large formation cannot be used in a short period of time.

When exactly?

In the formation, Jiang Bei slowly said, "Have you started to set up the formation from the beginning?"

Hearing this, Mu Yu nodded and smiled, "It's very smart, but now it's too late."

She is very confident now.

Although this kind of formation cannot be said to completely defeat Jiangbei, the effect is absolutely not bad, and it is enough for Jiangbei to drink a pot.

Sure enough, a terrifying aura suddenly poured out from the formation.

The power of killing!

In the dark, Qin Teng looked at the formation with a serious expression. If it were him, he would probably not be able to even walk out of the formation alive.

The gap in strength is too big.

"Your Majesty, can that martial god hold back the end of the Nine-Star Killing Formation of the Goddess General?"

Mr. Zhou stood behind Yan Lingyun and asked softly.

Yan Lingyun shook her head.

Seeing this, Old Zhou looked moved. Is the strength of the God of Martial Arts just like this?

Yan Lingyun said slowly, "What do you think is the God of Martial Arts?"

Hearing this, Mr. Zhou was stunned.

"The God of Martial Arts is not as simple as you think. In his eyes, this kind of formation is almost all flaws."

As soon as these words came out, Mr. Zhou looked shocked.

It seems that he has greatly underestimated this martial god.

However, it is not that the Nine Stars' ultimate killing formation is weak, but that Mu Yu is exercising it too hastily.

If it is prepared properly, even Jiangbei will not be able to break it easily.

At this time, in the Nine Stars' Killing Formation, Jiang Bei slowly breathed a sigh of relief, and then clenched his fists.

boom!

Suddenly, a terrifying force surged out.

"break!"

Boom!

As soon as he finished speaking, the entire formation shattered.

Seeing this scene, countless powerful people from the Divine Dynasty were extremely shocked.

"Break the surface with a point!"

I don't know who suddenly said in a lost voice.

At the same time, a figure had already rushed towards Mu Yu.

"Shepherd God will be careful!"

Upon hearing this, Mu Yu had already shown a hint of fear, but the other party was too fast and in a hurry, he had to raise his staff and block it.

Bang!

With a breaking sound.

The staff in his hand shattered.

"You lost."

The sound of Jiangbei sounded.

Looking at the broken staff in his hand, Mu Yu looked ugly, "You won."

After saying that, Mu Yu turned around and left.

At this moment, she was still in shock. The other party discovered the flaws of her formation, but the other party did not attack the weakness of the formation. Instead, she used the ultimate power to break the surface and smashed the entire formation.

And she was also subjected to some backlash due to the shattering of the formation.

So she is feeling very uncomfortable now.

In the void, Jiangbei stood quietly here.

I have to say that the strong men of the Divine Dynasty do have some strength, but it seems that they are not enough.

"Is there any more?"

Jiangbei said lightly.

The sound was not loud, but it spread throughout the entire Divine Dynasty.

For a moment, countless powerful people from the Divine Dynasty lowered their heads.

Even the third god general lost, and others will be spared unless those two come.

The martial god in the super-divine realm is so terrifying.

"Do you think you are strong?"

Buzz —

At this moment, a terrifying sword intent suddenly soared into the sky from afar.

Feeling this unique sword intent, the powerful men of the Divine Dynasty immediately said excitedly: "The Second God General!"

Jian Xin, the second-ranked god general in the Divine Dynasty!

He is also the only sword god in the Divine Dynasty!

"Sword intent is the god?"

Seeing the level of this sword intent, Jiang Bei suddenly became a little excited.

The next moment, a beautiful figure holding a long sword was already standing in front of Jiangbei.

Long hair is fluttering and heroic.

"Not anyone can insult my God Dynasty."

Jian Xin's face was cold, and he pointed at Jiangbei with a long sword in his hand and spoke slowly.

In an instant, the entire Divine Dynasty was in full bloom.

"Sword God! Sword God!!"

"The Second God General!"

Countless people from the Divine Dynasty cheered.

The second-ranked divine general in the Divine Dynasty is naturally terrifying.

Jian Xinzeng captured the entire star field with one sword.

The name of the Sword God spread throughout the heavens at that moment.

At this time, when Jiang Bei heard Jian Xin's words, he felt helpless. He had no intention of insulting the Divine Dynasty. From beginning to end, he just wanted to seek a powerful opponent.

But he also knew that it would be useless to say more.

After all, the facts are here.

"Come on, let me see if you, the sword god, have any moisture."

Hearing this, Jian Xin's expression moved slightly.

The next moment, the sound of the sword resounded throughout the world!
